'''Seland' Ir''' was a [[Verpine/Legends|Verpine]] [[Slavery/Legends|slaver]].

Although Ir's origin was a mystery, [[Gender/Legends|he]] was believed to be a pariah in his hive.

Ir was a methodical "project developer" for the [[Karazak Slavers' Cooperative/Legends|Karazak Slavers Cooperative]], and was among the most successful developers of the KSC as of [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]]. Absolutely methodical, he accepted high risks if he believed they would profit the Corporation.

Seland' Ir was the mastermind behind the kidnapping of [[Holovid/Legends|holovid]] star [[Janissa Locrin]]. Although his implication was a secret, the [[Sector Ranger/Legends|Sector Rangers]] managed to extract a confession from [[Iquar]], one of the strike team members who had worked in the operation.
